summary_1line: Krishna returns to the Kuru capital; Parikshit is born lifeless from Ashwatthama’s Brahma-weapon, and Kunti begs Krishna to revive the Pandava heir.

image_candidates.scene_text: Krishna rushes into the inner palace chambers as Kunti, Draupadi, and Subhadra weep around the motionless newborn prince.
Kunti raises her arms in despair before Krishna and collapses to the floor while the royal women cry over the lifeless child.
The infant Parikshit lies still after birth while the palace that had just echoed with celebratory shouts falls into sudden silence.
